# Logic sub-actions

## Ask me for input (popup)

Opens a small window on your computer asking you to type something, then saves your answer in a variable. Handy for actions you start yourself, like asking for a new title.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The text at the top of the window. The default is Cuebot. Starts as: `Cuebot`. |
| **Prompt** | The question shown in the window, like "Which game next?". Starts as: `Enter a value`. |
| **Original text** | Text already in the box when the window opens. Empty = an empty box. |
| **Output variable** | The variable that receives your answer, without % signs. The default inputResult means you use %inputResult% later. Starts as: `inputResult`. |
| **Auto type output** | Tick so a number you type is saved as a real number and not just text. Untick if unsure. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if you pressed OK, false if you cancelled or no window could open |
| `%inputResult%` | What you typed (the variable name can be changed in the settings) |

<small>Type id: `core.getInputDialog`</small>

## If

Checks something, then runs different steps depending on the answer. Example: IF %message% contains "hello" THEN say hi back. Steps go under True (yes) or False (no).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Value** | The thing to look at, usually a %variable% like %user% or %message%. For "exists" and "does not exist" type only the variable's name, like targetUser. Starts as: `%message%`. |
| **Operator** | How to compare. "equals" = the same. "contains" = has it inside. "greater than" and "less than" compare numbers. "is empty" = nothing there. "matches regex" is an advanced search pattern. Options: equals, not equals, contains, does not contain, starts with, ends with, greater than, less than, is empty, is not empty, matches regex, does not exist, exists. Starts as: `equals`. |
| **Compare to** | What to compare with, like hello or 100. Capital letters do not matter. Not used for "is empty", "is not empty", "exists" and "does not exist". |

Paths it can take: **True**, **False**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%match.count%` | Only with "matches regex": how many pieces matched |
| `%match[0]%` | Only with "matches regex": the text that matched (match[1] is the first captured piece) |

<small>Type id: `core.if`</small>

## Loop break

Stops the loop you are in right now and carries on with the step after the loop. Use it inside a While loop. Outside a loop it stops the whole action.

<small>Type id: `core.loopBreak`</small>

## Loop continue

Skips the rest of this round of the loop and starts the next round straight away. Use it inside a While loop. Outside a loop it stops the whole action.

<small>Type id: `core.loopContinue`</small>

## Run action

Runs another action from this one, like calling a helper. Good for reusing the same steps in many actions. The other action gets a copy of this action's variables.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Action** | The other action's name, exactly as in your Actions list, like "Play alert sound". A wrong name gives an error. |
| **Wait for it to finish** | Ticked: this action waits until the other one is done before the next step. Unticked: both run at the same time. Starts as: `true`. |

<small>Type id: `core.runAction`</small>

## Split text into inputs

Cuts a text into pieces and gives each piece its own variable: %input0%, %input1% and so on. Handy for chat like "!give kris 50".

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Text** | The text to cut up. The default %rawInput% is what a viewer typed after a command. Starts as: `%rawInput%`. |
| **Separator** | What to cut at, like a comma. Empty cuts at spaces. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%input0%` | The first piece (input1 is the second, and so on) |
| `%inputCount%` | How many pieces there are |

<small>Type id: `core.getInput`</small>

## Stop action

Stops this action right here. The steps below it do not run. Usually put inside an If, like "if the viewer has too few points, stop".

<small>Type id: `core.stop`</small>

## Switch

Like several Ifs in one. It looks at one value and runs the steps of the first case that matches. Example: !color red or blue or green. "Default" runs if nothing matches.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Value** | The value to look at, usually a %variable% like %message% or %input0%. Starts as: `%message%`. |
| **Cases** | One case per line, like red. Put several words on one line with \| between them (red\|crimson) for the same steps. The first match wins. |
| **Match with** | How each case is compared with the value: "equals" = the same, "contains" = has it inside, and so on. Capital letters do not matter. Options: equals, not equals, contains, does not contain, starts with, ends with, greater than, less than, is empty, is not empty, matches regex. Starts as: `equals`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%switchCase%` | The case line that matched, or Default |

<small>Type id: `core.switch`</small>

## While

Repeats the steps inside as long as a check is true, like "while the count is below 5, do this". Handy for doing something several times. It has a safety limit.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Value** | The thing to look at each round, usually a %variable%. The default %loopIteration% counts rounds starting at 0. Starts as: `%loopIteration%`. |
| **Operator** | How to compare, like "less than" or "equals". "less than" with 10 repeats while the value is below 10. Options: equals, not equals, contains, does not contain, starts with, ends with, greater than, less than, is empty, is not empty, matches regex. Starts as: `less than`. |
| **Compare to** | What to compare with, like 10. The default repeats 10 times (rounds 0 to 9). Starts as: `10`. |
| **Safety limit (iterations, 0 = none)** | The most rounds allowed, so a mistake can never loop forever. 0 = no limit (risky). Starts as: `10000`. |

Paths it can take: **Body**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%loopIteration%` | Which round you are on, starting at 0 |

<small>Type id: `core.while`</small>
